title: A free question connects differences clearly

captions.emotions: Feeling different aspects come into accord

meaning: A free question can connect different aspects of experience clearly while preserving the foundations of each impression within your shared view.
text: Different impressions can come into accord after a simple free clarification. The Fool in the physical position of Ajna suggests asking beyond a familiar explanation. The Sun in energy supports clear meaning in ordinary words. Temperance in emotions feels harmony between aspects. You enjoy seeing both versions belong to actual experience.

For example, you compare impressions of a new park and ask, “Do we mean the same thing by convenient?” One person means a nearby entrance, the other long walking without crossing a road. **A free question lets clarity connect different foundations.** Your personal assessments need not cancel each other. One route suits a brief outing, another a longer walk. Harmony comes from the relationship you saw. A shared language preserves the case’s features and clarifies wishes without declaring the whole park equally convenient or inconvenient for every future visit.

The risk is making pleasant harmony a need always to find a unifying formula. Difference is understood while conversation continues for final smoothness. Seeking clarity can preserve sufficiency. You understand each other’s reasons and may leave preferences distinct. A shared view supports discussion when words express actual conditions and harmony does not require concealing a detail outside the ready explanation.
